rows.title: Film Review: The Terrorizers (1986) by Edward Yang
rows.comment: Dues to Yang’s precise direction and the overall great performances of his ensemble cast
rows.verdict_le10: Dues to Yang’s precise direction and the overall great performances of his ensemble cast
rows.dek_lead: In the end, “The Terrorizers” is a strong blend of drama and crime as well as an intriguing portrayal of the city and its inhabitants. Dues to Yang’s precise direction and the overall great performances of his ensemble cast
